about_the_game:
World of Goo 2 Official Soundtrack

Kyle Gabler & Jonny Trengrove

Clocking in at over 47 tracks and nearly 2 hours of music, our own Kyle Gabler worked with new member of our team Jonny Trengrove, and over 50 musicians from the World of Goo community to bring you the beautiful, the haunting, the hilarious, the thrilling, World of Goo 2 Original Soundtrack.

For those curious about the process, Kyle and Jonny wrote music, and then provided each musician with a click track for timing, as well as some melody and harmony lines to play and/or improvise around. Each musician then recorded themselves at home, at school, etc. And then we edited it all together. The results are often surprising, and became something better than we ever imagined. This is a process we hope to use again in the future!
